scope: Descriptive comparison on 300 already-exposed fixed IDs, not controlled architecture comparison
metrics: modern-correct old-wrong / old-correct modern-wrong / both-correct / both-wrong with IDs
review_selection: One lowest lexicographic pairID modern-error per subcase; list all error IDs, do not cherry-pick
limits: No confidence intervals or significance claims on this small nonrandom sample. Training, architecture, tokenization and era all differ. No model tuning, no new inference. Rust controls remain researcher-authored development hypotheses.
